_comment: Cleaning rules. Nothing is ever deleted from raw/ - excluded patients land in output/quarantine.csv with a reason, flagged ones stay in the data with a review_flag.
_raw_dir_comment: Where the archive of downloaded exports lives. Empty = the raw/ folder next to this file. Point it at a synced folder (e.g. a Google Drive folder marked 'available offline') to share ONE archive across your machines. Outputs are always written locally next to the code and must NOT be synced - they are rebuilt on every run.
_missing_comment: The source writes this token in EVERY field of a questionnaire that was sent but never answered. It is not the same as a blank item on a form the patient DID answer, and the two must not be merged - one is questionnaire non-response, the other is item-level skipping.
_safety_comment: A patient with at least this many measurement occasions is NEVER auto-excluded, no matter which rule fires - they get review_flag instead. This is what stops a placeholder like 'XX' from deleting a real 300-session patient. Set to 0 to disable the guard.
_exclude_comment: Rules below are confident enough to remove the patient outright.
_review_comment: Rules below only FLAG - the patient stays in the dataset. Move a pattern up to the exclude list once you've confirmed it.
_completeness_comment: An item counts toward completeness only if it is actually in use - answered in at least this share of that questionnaire's answered occasions. Stops a dead/conditional item from marking every occasion 'partial'. See output/item_usage.csv.
_weekly_comment: The weekly session battery. 'required_for_complete_week' decides what counts as a complete week - edit to loosen or tighten.
